name: Frontier-CS Polyominoes packing
description: Provide a C++17 program (as the SOLUTION_CPP string) that chooses a W x H rectangle and places 100 to 10000 polyominoes, with optional rotation and reflection, on distinct cells inside it; scored by the official checker's mean of total cells / (W*H) x 100 over 70 Frontier-CS test cases, failed cases scoring 0 (higher is better).
